doubts: This page is an overview of four options to reach Angelus Hut (Pinchgut Track/Robert Ridge Route, Speargrass Track/Speargrass Creek Route, Travers – Cascade Track/Route, Mt Cedric Track/Route), each linked as its own walk. The text names the end (Angelus Hut) but gives no start place for any option, so no ways are recorded (rule 16). The winter section says the Robert Ridge Route or Travers-Cascade Route go via Lakehead Hut or Coldwater Hut and the Mt Cedric Track via Sabine Hut, but which hut belongs to which route is not stated. Rotomaninitua/Lake Angelus is beside the hut; the Speargrass option is said to be used to exit it in bad weather. The option walks and their huts are recorded under not_on_route only because their routes are described on their own pages.
